caption: The first screen of the onboarding of Postscript on the vendor site: the heading Welcome to Postscript!, a text that the average Postscript customer generates 18% of their store's revenue with Postscript (a statement of the vendor that we did not test), that the next 5 minutes walk through the set-up and that the store is synced in the background, a progress bar at 1/10 and a button Continue; no name, e-mail address or avatar is visible, and the chat bubble in the bottom right corner is the generic icon of the vendor.

The modal Add a billing address that opened after Continue, with the fields Country/region (United States), Address line 1 (100 Test Street, a made up test address), Address line 2 (optional), City (Austin), State/province (Texas, chosen from the list) and Postal code (78701) and a button Save; the address is test data and not a real address; no name, e-mail address or avatar is visible.

Step 2 of 10, Contact information: empty required fields First name, Last name, Phone number (with the country code +1) and Email address with the line Use an email only you control. You'll use it to access your account., the unchecked boxes I agree to receive text updates, I understand and agree to Postscript's terms of service. (required) and I agree to receive marketing emails from Postscript., and a greyed out button Continue next to Back at 2/10; all fields are empty, so nothing of ours is visible.
